params.name: platformAccountId
params.description: The RippleNet platform account ID that you want to get a statement for. Example: `bitso`

params.name: start-date
params.description: The lower bound of the date-time range you want to return statement information for, as an ISO-8601 timestamp in UTC. For example, `2018-08-06T23:13:55.997Z`.

params.name: end-date
params.description: The upper bound of the date-time range you want to return statement information for, as an ISO-8601 timestamp in UTC For example, `2018-08-06T23:15:13.218Z`.

params.name: page
params.description:
The page number for [paginated results](/products/payments-odl/api-docs/ripplenet/best-practices/pagination/). The value is zero-based, where `0` represents the first page.
Set it to `0` to get the first page of results.

params.name: size
params.description: Number of payment and transfer objects to return per page.
